strategy.summary: Spell M-U-L-T-I, start Gladiators Multiball at the mystery saucer, then use the M and T ramps for both jackpots, the 100M Super, and the 200M Ultimate.

quickInfo.name: M-U-L-T-I
quickInfo.summary: The M ramp, loop sides, T ramp, and spinner/lock path complete the five Gladiators Multiball letters.

quickInfo.name: Gladiators Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After M-U-L-T-I is complete, shoot the mystery saucer to start two-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Ramp sequence
quickInfo.summary: Two M-ramp jackpots open two larger T-ramp awards: Super, then Ultimate.

quickInfo.name: Pyramid rounds
quickInfo.summary: Start rounds at the mode saucer; hitting the multiball target three times can make the next round two-ball.

quickInfo.name: Attack Mode
quickInfo.summary: Match the blue and yellow tracks, lock at the M ramp, then time the crane release into the catapult saucer.

quickInfo.name: Weapons
quickInfo.summary: Alternate the U and L loop shots to spell W-E-A-P-O-N, then collect a weapon choice at the Abyss.

quickInfo.name: Everything Doubled 2x playfield scoring
quickInfo.summary: Complete DOUBLE at the catapult saucer to double all scoring for the rest of the ball.

steps.text: Test both ramps, the loop, and the saucer eject before committing to M-U-L-T-I.
Complete M-U-L-T-I from the safest available letters.
modeNotes: Letter map: M is the M ramp, U and L are the two sides of the U-L loop, T is the T ramp, and I is the spinner and lock path.

steps.text: Shoot the mystery saucer to start Gladiators Multiball once the word is complete.
During Gladiators Multiball, shoot the M ramp twice for the two opening jackpots.
Move to the T ramp for the Super, then repeat it for the Ultimate award before the lights time out.
If another Pyramid round is ready, use protected play to hit the multiball target three times before starting the round.
After Gladiators Multiball, resume only the M-U-L-T-I letters that remain safely available; later qualifications can regress on a timer.

fallback.title: Pyramid round route
fallback.when: Use this when a Gladiators Multiball shot rejects but the mode saucer is safe.

steps.text: Shoot the mode saucer to start the next Pyramid round.
Hit the multiball target three times if doing so is controlled.
Start the round at the mode saucer and use the second ball to complete its lit objectives.

alternatives.title: Doubled weapon cashout
alternatives.when: Use this when DOUBLE and W-E-A-P-O-N are both close and the catapult and Abyss feeds are understood.

steps.text: Finish DOUBLE at the catapult saucer for Everything Doubled 2x playfield scoring.
Alternate U and L to finish W-E-A-P-O-N.
Shoot the Abyss and choose the weapon that best advances the current route.
Return to M-U-L-T-I while 2x playfield scoring remains active.

alternatives.title: Attack Mode
alternatives.when: Use this when blue and yellow progress is already balanced through incidental target and sling hits.

steps.text: Match the two color-progress tracks.
Start Attack Mode without forcing extra drop-target hits.
Shoot the M ramp to lock the ball, then time the crane release into the catapult saucer.
Return to M-U-L-T-I when Attack Mode ends.
Complete the Pyramid rounds in order.
Use prepared two-ball rounds to preserve progress.
Finish Calm Before the Storm.
Enter Beast Challenge with the ramp and saucer feeds already tested.

techniques.name: M-ramp before T-ramp order
techniques.instruction: Finish both M-ramp jackpots before switching to the T ramp for Super and Ultimate.

techniques.name: Two-ball round preparation
techniques.instruction: Before starting a Pyramid round, use three controlled multiball-target hits to add protection to the next round.

cautions.issue: The drop targets and Abyss return can send the ball directly toward the drain.
cautions.response: Use protected play for those objectives and prefer the ramp route in single-ball play.

cautions.issue: Later M-U-L-T-I qualifications and jackpot lights can time out.
cautions.response: Begin the sequence only when the next required shot is available; do not pause for unrelated awards.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm installed code and settings for ball saves, round timers, Extra Ball conversion, and the later Gladiators Multiball letter-regression timer.
Test both ramps, both saucers, the Abyss feed, upper-right-flipper trap, and crane release before choosing the main route.
Verify DOUBLE progress and whether Everything Doubled remains active for the rest of the ball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Five M-U-L-T-I letters qualify Gladiators' Multiball at the mystery saucer. During two-ball play, shoot the M ramp twice, then the T ramp for Super and again for Ultimate. Start Pyramid rounds at the mode saucer, spell W-E-A-P-O-N through the U and L loops, and complete DOUBLE at the catapult saucer between starts.
strategy.overview: Gladiators uses M-U-L-T-I to qualify its repeatable Multiball ladder at the mystery saucer. Prioritize safe letters, then execute the M-ramp pair and T-ramp Super and Ultimate. Collect a prepared weapon or complete DOUBLE at the catapult saucer when either award is ready before the Multiball start.

Test both ramps, both saucers, the Abyss feed, upper-right-flipper trap, and crane release before choosing the main route.
Verify DOUBLE progress and whether Everything Doubled remains active for the rest of the ball.
